initial_message:
Build the public booking page requested below.

Use the documented Design MCP workflow. Call the connected direct tool once with the
brief verbatim as its only argument. Use a reasonable default for an optional question.
Return one complete HTML file in an html code fence. Keep behavior local and any
artwork original. Use inline CSS and JavaScript and only Google Fonts for remote
resources. Use no shell, file writes, or other tools. If the next user message is
a one-word reaction, call react with the exact word and the returned direction ID.
Apply that advice while keeping the booking facts and the working behavior. Return
the full revised HTML in the same format.

Brief:
Second Spin is a local bike shop at 41 Elm Street. It offers a tune-up that takes 48 hours for $85. Bookings are Tuesday to Saturday. Let a visitor choose one of those days by keyboard or pointer and see the booking summary, with no invented availability, dates, fees or contact details. make it feel premium.

scope: Fresh client session on the README package pin. No surface hint. Separate installed stdio replies for vague, contradictory and routine briefs.
